name: ignore ambiguous timing samples and back off the timer
mechanism: do not update the round-trip estimate from acknowledgements of retransmitted messages (their timing is ambiguous), and double the timeout on each retransmission until a fresh unambiguous sample arrives

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Karn's algorithm' in section Networking: addresses the problem of getting accurate estimates of the round-trip time for messages when using TCP

fails_when: a sustained loss burst inflates the timer for a while
